name: EasyDash for Bricks
author: Simrandeep Singh

sections.description:
Introducing EasyDash by Max Addons – a free plugin to take full control over the WordPress welcome panel using Bricks Builder. With EasyDash, you can personalize the WordPress dashboard just like any other page in Bricks.

✅ Add headings, contact details, forms, videos, images, affiliate links, and more

✅ Customize the layout and design

✅ Display different dashboard templates based on user roles

Why Use EasyDash?

As a WordPress user, you’re familiar with the dashboard, but your clients? Not so much! Make their experience smoother by creating a custom, user-friendly dashboard that fits their needs.

EasyDash lets you design a dashboard using Bricks Builder—no need to learn a new interface!

Who Is EasyDash For?

EasyDash is perfect for anyone with a WordPress website built using Bricks Builder. While anyone can customize their dashboard, it’s especially useful for:

✅ Web designers & agencies

✅ WordPress developers

✅ Site owners who want a branded, user-friendly dashboard

How It Works?

Setting up a custom WordPress dashboard is as easy as:

1️⃣ Install & activate EasyDash

2️⃣ Create a new template in Bricks Builder

3️⃣ Customize it with content, layouts, and branding

4️⃣ Assign the template to specific user roles from the EasyDash settings

5️⃣ Save & Done!

Give your clients an experience they’ll love! ♥️

Our other Bricks Builder addons

Max Addons for Bricks – Extend Bricks Builder with 50+ Creative Widgets and build beautiful websites.
Bricks Element Manager – Manage default Bricks Builder elements with easy to use interface within WP admin dashboard.
sections.installation:
1. Install EasyDash for Bricks either via the WordPress plugin directory or by uploading the files to your server at wp-content/plugins.

  2. Activate the plugin.

  3. Create a new template in Bricks Builder

  4. Assign the template to specific user roles from the EasyDash settings

  5. Save & Done!
sections.faq:
What’s the requirement for using EasyDash for Bricks?

You need Bricks theme installed and activated for EasyDash to work.

Do I need coding experience to use EasyDash for Bricks?

Not at all! All you need to know about Bricks Builder.
